info.title: Employee Service
info.description: Employee master data capabilities offer a holistic view of internal employees (a business partner person with valid employee type 'isInternalEmployee'). It allows you to maintain all relevant data for your internal employees such as basic data (name, workplace address, communication data), sales responsibility data, working hours information, and so on.

servers.description: Example of server url is https://my1234567.crm.cloud.sap

get.description: Specify query parameters to return desired employee records from the system.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Show only the first n employees.

parameters.name: $search
parameters.description: Search for a string within employees.

one.summary: Employee display ID in ascending order

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Indicates the count of employees to be returned.

400.description:
Bad Request.

The server cannot process the request due to a client error. For example, an invalid request.

401.description:
Unauthorized.

This error is caused when the request has not been applied because there are no valid authentication credentials for the target resource.

403.description: User is not authorized to query employees in the system. Check user's authorization under Settings - Users and Control - Business Roles

500.description:
Internal Server Error.

Failed to query employees.

501.description: The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.

post.description: Send employee information to the system to create a new employee.

one.summary: Create of a basic internal employee by providing a unique employee display ID.

two.summary: Create an internal employee with workplace address and employee sales responsibility.

201.description: A new employee is created in the system.

400.description: Employee is not created in the system. The request sent to the system is invalid.

401.description: User is not authenticated to create a new employee in the system.

403.description: User is not authorized to create an employee in the system. Check user's authorization under Settings - Users and Control - Business Roles

500.description: Failed to create an employee due to an internal server error.

get.description: Read a specific employee using the employee ID.

200.description: Employee with the requested ID is found in the system.

400.description: Invalid Request. Failed to read the employee information.

401.description: User is not authenticated to read the employee information in the system.

403.description: User is not authorized to read employee information in the system. Check user's authorization under Settings - Users and Control - Business Roles

404.description: Employee with the request ID is not found in the system.

500.description: Failed to read the employee due to an internal server error.

patch.description: Update employee attributes in the system.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Used for conflict management when a consumer tries to update a resource. This parameter checks if the state of the resource known to the client (etag) matches the state on the server and if true, allows the update to continue.

400.description: Invalid request. Failed to update the employee.

401.description: User is not authenticated to update the employee in the system.

403.description: User is not authorized to update the employee in the system. Check user's authorization under Settings - Users and Control - Business Roles

412.description: Failed to update the employee. The employee was updated in a parallel session. Try again with a new if-match http header value.

428.description: Failed to update the employee. The mandatory http header if-match was not sent in http request header.

500.description: Failed to update the employee due to an internal server error.
